self = <test_logClass.TestLogClassSession object at 0x7f0294a75e50>

    @pytest.mark.priority(24)
    @allure.title(
        "Given coach adds weight for user ABC via log class session, when this user's dashboard is opened, "
        "then this weight data should be plotted on the weight history graph"
    )
    def test_verify_log_class_data_on_dashboard_weight_history(self):
        self.reset_classes()
        self.page.reload()
        self.go_to_log_class_session(via_direct_message=True)
    
        weight_value_added_in_log_class = "90"
        weight_input = self.logClassSessionPage.weight_input("lokesh")
        weight_input.fill("")
        weight_input.fill(weight_value_added_in_log_class)
    
        yesterday_date = self.get_yesterday_date()
        date_input = self.logClassSessionPage.date_input("lokesh")
        date_input.fill("")
        date_input.fill(yesterday_date)
        time.sleep(3)
        self.logClassSessionPage.save_button("lokesh").click()
        time.sleep(3)  # required to ease the fast-save race, same as the original
    
        # navigate to user dashboard and check weight history
        LogClassSessionPage.result_link_for(self, "lokesh").click()
    
        weight_history_heading = self.page.locator("xpath=(//b[text()='Weight History'])")
        expect(weight_history_heading).to_be_visible(timeout=15000)
        self.page.reload()
        expect(weight_history_heading).to_be_visible(timeout=15000)
        time.sleep(3)
    
        graph_circle = self.page.locator("xpath=(//*[name()='circle'])[1]")
        expect(graph_circle).to_be_visible(timeout=15000)
        graph_circle.hover()
        time.sleep(3)
    
        plotted_value = self.page.locator(
            f"xpath=(//*[name()='text'][text()='{weight_value_added_in_log_class}'])[1]"
        )
